verdict.rationale: LangGraph is an open-source pip-installable framework (langgraph-gh-5) with a CLI to build and run the Agent Server locally, including a managed database for checkpointing/storage (langgraph-docs-30, langgraph-docs-37), and checkpointers can be backed by self-managed databases like Postgres (langgraph-docs-13), confirming core self-hosting is fully supported. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of running the full self-hosted stack in production, and clarity on which 'Agent Server' features are open-source vs. LangSmith-gated (community notes questions about deploying beyond local `langgraph serve`, langgraph-comm-5).
